title: Warm Gooey Peruvian Semolina Tiradito
description: A quick-fix Peruvian dish featuring semolina flour, tandoor, and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, this tiradito is a floral and gooey delight. It combines the flavors of semolina, tandoor, and Peruvian aji amarillo peppers.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together semolina flour, tandoor seasoning, and salt.
Gradually add water and olive oil to the bowl, stirring until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle lemon juice and sprinkle garlic and aji amarillo peppers over the disks.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 2 minutes before serving.
